fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-05-26, the complainant paid Rs. 40,000 to a person who promised a job placement, but no appointment order was provided and calls went unanswered. The time of the incident was given as 09:00 on 2026-05-24. The complaint was lodged by Sanjay Raj (9000000083). Ramya Bai was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The complaint mentions Gopal Mani, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000457, in connection with the events. Another person, Madhan Babu, using the number 9000000490, was named as potentially involved. A further person, Logesh Karuppasamy, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000198, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant mentioned digital documents, social media screenshots and physical documents.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Digital document; Social media screenshot; Physical document
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly issued a forged offer letter and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, screenshot, morning, residential colony, associate, mobile number, digital document
